name: Kingdom Hearts (1.5+2.5 / 2.8 collection)
notes: Same setup as Birth by Sleep: Steam Input off, game rumble and sound become HD haptics. KH1 and KH2: game state (HP, MP, battles, cutscenes) is read automatically - hits, healing, low-HP heartbeat, spell casts and boss alerts are felt in the haptics, triggers and lightbar.
